P: 1. Obtain a 12-lead ECG now and assess hemodynamic stability; check BMP, magnesium, CBC and thyroid tests; arrange same-day emergency department evaluation for rate/rhythm and stroke-risk assessment; explain uncertainty until ECG confirmation and seek emergency help for chest pain, syncope or worsening dyspnea.

3. Obtain TSH with reflex thyroid hormones; examine for thyroid signs and review weight/heat intolerance; refer for targeted treatment if results support thyroid disease.
